ideas.title: Investigation into Government Misconduct
ideas.description: This story would investigate the various forms of government misconduct, including the Worcester Police Department investigation and the Federal Wildfire Response investigation.
ideas.angle: The investigation would focus on the need for increased oversight and accountability within government agencies.
questions: What forms of government misconduct are being investigated?
What are the consequences of these investigations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread government misconduct and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability.
